_comment: Tier-2 for _general.vtk_time_series_measured.Signal. Measured 2026-08-06 on dune-fem 2.12.0.2, wall time 2 s in a temp dir: ten calls to gridView.writeVTK('overwritten', pointdata=...) left exactly ONE file, ['overwritten.vtu'] — each call overwrites the last, which is the whole claim. The same ten steps with number=step produced ten files whose first three are series00000.vtu, series00001.vtu, series00002.vtu, i.e. a zero-padded five-digit suffix. No .pvd collection file was written, so ParaView has to open the sequence by pattern. dune.grid.OutputType exposes exactly appendedbase64, appendedraw, ascii, base64, and outputType=OutputType.ascii produced a .vtu whose head contains '<VTKFile'. The fixture has a synthetic physics key because the claim lives in the _general measured sections, not in a pitfalls list.
